preconditions.description: n is a positive integer between 1 and 10000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The return value is a string of length exactly n.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: The string contains only the characters '0' and '1'.
The i-th character (0-indexed) is '0' if the number of 1s in the binary representation of i is even, and '1' if it is odd, which defines the Thue-Morse sequence.
